includeConnectors.description: Also audit each connector pin against its latest-in-major from Exchange Graph (the connector-staleness half). Default true. Set false for a gating-only drift check.

candidate.description: Also return a PROPOSED candidate matrix whose drifting connector pins are bumped to their latest-in-major. A review artifact only — never persisted; the curated matrix stays authoritative. Default false.

noFetch.description: Skip ALL network. The gating drift check degrades to 'unchecked' and connector staleness to 'unknown'. Default false.
